canonical_identifiers.title: Peptide-Based Membrane Fusion Inhibitors Targeting HCoV-229E Spike Protein HR1 and HR2 Domains.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: 229E-HR1P and 229E-HR2P interact to form a stable six-helix-bundle-like complex, supporting the intended HR1/HR2 fusion-core target model.
source_locators: xml:sec=3:2.1. Design and Biophysical Characterization of 229E-HR1P and 229E-HR2P

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=3:2.1. Design and Biophysical Characterization of 229E-HR1P and 229E-HR2P; xml:fig=2:Figure 2

mechanism_claims.evidence_notes: N-PAGE shows new complex bands when 229E-HR1P is mixed with 229E-HR2P; CD/Tm evidence supports a helical bundle with Tm 90.1°C.
mechanism_claims.strength_notes: Direct biophysical target-engagement evidence; it supports fusion-core mimicry but does not alone prove antiviral efficacy.
mechanism_claims.summary: Biophysical assays support HR1/HR2 six-helix-bundle interaction.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Both peptides inhibit HCoV-229E S protein-mediated cell-cell fusion, with 229E-HR2P more potent than 229E-HR1P.
direct_assay_types: HCoV-229E S-mediated cell-cell fusion inhibition assay
source_locators: xml:sec=5:2.3. HCoV-229E HR1P and HR2P Peptides Inhibited HCoV-229E S Protein-Mediated Cell-Cell Fusion

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=5:2.3. HCoV-229E HR1P and HR2P Peptides Inhibited HCoV-229E S Protein-Mediated Cell-Cell Fusion; xml:fig=4:Figure 4

mechanism_claims.evidence_notes: Figure 4b reports IC50 values of 5.70 µM for 229E-HR1P and 0.31 µM for 229E-HR2P against HCoV-229E S-mediated cell-cell fusion, while VSV G fusion is not significantly inhibited up to 10 µM.
mechanism_claims.strength_notes: Direct functional evidence for fusion inhibition; VSV G control supports specificity for the coronavirus S-mediated fusion system.
mechanism_claims.summary: Cell-cell fusion assays support HCoV-229E fusion inhibition.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: 229E-HR2P, and less potently 229E-HR1P, inhibit HCoV-229E pseudovirus entry and live-virus infection/replication phenotypes without detectable cytotoxicity up to the tested limit.
mechanism_claims.evidence_notes: Figure 5 reports pseudovirus and live-virus IC50 values; Figure 6/text report no significant cytotoxicity in Huh-7/A549 cells up to 1000 µM.
mechanism_claims.strength_notes: Phenotypic antiviral support consistent with fusion inhibition. It should not be reframed as antibacterial activity, anticancer activity, or a nucleic-acid interaction mechanism.
mechanism_claims.summary: Antiviral infection assays support functional activity with low cytotoxicity in tested cells.

mechanism_summary: The paper supports an HCoV-229E fusion-inhibitor mechanism through HR1/HR2 peptide interaction and HCoV-229E S-mediated fusion inhibition. It does not support antibacterial, anticancer, nucleic-acid, or nonspecific membrane-permeabilization claims for these records.

entity_mechanism_summary.229E-HR1P: HR1-derived peptide; weaker inhibitor in HCoV-229E S fusion, pseudovirus, and live-virus assays.
entity_mechanism_summary.229E-HR2P: HR2-derived peptide; more potent HCoV-229E fusion/pseudovirus/live-virus inhibitor and active in respiratory lavage model.

absence_and_boundary_notes: No direct antibacterial MIC/MBC mechanism is reported in this paper.
No anticancer activity assay is reported in this paper despite CAMP database wording.
No direct nucleic-acid binding mechanism is supported by the local source material.
